chapters.title: The Glory of Agni — The Cosmic Fire

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निर्देवो द्विजातीनां मुनीनां हृदि देवताम् ।
प्रतिमास्वल्पबुद्धीनां सर्वत्र समदर्शिनाम् ॥
verses.translation: Agni (fire) is the deity of the twice-born; for the sages, God resides in the heart. For those of limited understanding, God is in images. But for the wise, God is seen equally everywhere.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मशास्त्रं समग्रमेव परमार्थं प्रकाशयत् ।
अग्निपुराणे सर्वं विद्यानां संग्रहो मतः ॥
verses.translation: The Agni Purana illuminates the entire science of dharma and the supreme truth. It is regarded as a compendium of all branches of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निरूवाच ।
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय वक्ष्यामि ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
धर्मं च अर्थं च कामं च मोक्षं चैव चतुर्विधम् ॥
verses.translation: Agni said: For the welfare of all the worlds, I shall speak the highest knowledge — covering dharma, artha, kama, and moksha, the four goals of life.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्स्यः कूर्मो वराहश्च नारसिंहो वामनस्तथा ।
रामो रामश्च कृष्णश्च बुद्धः कल्किश्च ते दश ॥
verses.translation: Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Parashurama, Rama, Krishna, Buddha, and Kalki — these are the ten avatars.

verses.sanskrit:
एतेषां दशावताराणां कथा लोकहितावहाः ।
श्रद्धया शृणुयाद्यस्तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.translation: The stories of these ten avatars are beneficial to the world. Whoever hears them with faith is freed from all sins.
